description: Bring a region from a DIMMED neighbouring screenshot (pop-up/alert shot of the same screen) into an undimmed screenshot: undim the donor with factor 0.6 (measured on Billing Activity pop-up shots: 153/255; copy the recipe and change it if another screen measures differently), then paste the region at a fixed position. Used for: removing an open Settlement Type drop-down (Billing Activity Single Invoice) using the alert shot as donor.

inputs.donor: dimmed neighbouring screenshot of the same screen
inputs.region: x0,y0,x1,y1 of the area in the DONOR
inputs.x: target x of the region's top-left
inputs.y: target y of the region's top-left
